info.title: KarryGo Vendor Service — Section 9A: Food Catalogue Foundation
info.description:
The management-side authoritative answer to "what does this vendor branch sell": menus, sections, items, variants, modifier groups, modifiers and item/modifier-group relationships.

MANAGEMENT, NOT DISCOVERY. Every route here is behind a vendor staff session and a catalogue permission. A management GET is not customer discovery; Section 9C owns the read/consumption contract, and nothing in this document should be exposed to a customer app.

MONEY IS INTEGER MINOR UNITS. Base prices, variant overrides and modifier deltas are integers in the business's own ISO-4217 currency, which is owned by Section 6 and never restated on a catalogue row. There is no floating-point money and no per-item currency anywhere in this contract.

CAPABILITY BOUNDARY. Only RESTAURANT and FAST_FOOD menus exist in this section. A branch must hold the capability before a menu can be created for it, and the business, branch and capability must all be ACTIVE before that menu can be published — read from the existing Section 6/7 state rather than re-decided here.

ARCHIVE, NEVER DELETE. Catalogue entities are archived and retained so a future order, dispute or analytics record that names one keeps resolving. The single exception is the item/modifier-group relationship row, which carries no historical authority of its own.

NOT IN THIS SECTION. No schedules, no sold-out state, no branch price or preparation overrides, no effective-price or availability resolver, no price history (Section 9B). No discovery, projection, search or internal consumption API (Section 9C). No orders, no cart, no checkout, no inventory, no dispatch and no wallet call — a catalogue price is commercial configuration, not settlement.

put.summary: Attach a modifier group to an item
put.description: Links a shared, business-level group to one item. A second attachment of the same group is refused as a duplicate rather than creating a second link. An archived group and an archived item both refuse attachment. A branch-scoped actor may attach on their own branch's items: attaching is a decision about one item, not an edit of the shared definition.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Replays the stored response for the same key and request, and reports a conflict for the same key with a different request. The same store Sections 6, 7 and 8 use; this section introduces no second mechanism.

SectionId.name: sectionId
SectionId.description: Menu section identifier, which must belong to the addressed menu.

VariantId.name: variantId
VariantId.description: Variant identifier, which must belong to the addressed item.

ModifierId.name: modifierId
ModifierId.description: Modifier identifier, which must belong to the addressed group.

BranchRef.name: branch_id
BranchRef.description: Restricts the list to one branch. A branch outside the caller's scope is refused rather than answered empty.

CapabilityFilter.name: capability_type
CapabilityFilter.description: Restricts the list to one food capability.

MenuStatusFilter.name: status
MenuStatusFilter.description: Restricts the list to one lifecycle state.

IncludeArchived.name: include_archived
IncludeArchived.description: Includes archived rows, which are always ordered behind the live ones.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size. Every list endpoint is bounded.

FoodCapability.description: Section 9A's exact capability boundary. CLOUD_KITCHEN, PASTRY_BAKERY, SHOP_GROCERY, MARKET and WHOLESALE are real KarryGo capabilities but are not this section's, and are refused here.

MenuStatus.description: DRAFT is editable and unpublished. ACTIVE is the published management state. PAUSED is an administrative withdrawal, not Section 9B's sold-out or schedule state. ARCHIVED is terminal and is never reactivated.

ItemStatus.description: The same closed lifecycle as a menu. PAUSED is administrative; a temporary sold-out condition belongs to Section 9B and cannot be expressed here.

ChildStatus.description: Sections, variants, modifier groups and modifiers are either part of the catalogue or retired from it.

MetadataCode.description: A declarative, vendor-supplied catalogue code, normalised to upper case and de-duplicated. The narrow shape is deliberate: it can express any vendor vocabulary while making it impossible to put markup, a query or a URL into what is displayed as a dietary claim.

branch_id.description: The branch this menu belongs to. Not editable.
